source.otherStates: saved get_screenshot render, 320x608 px; further contexts were quota-limited

geometry.note: Figma's outer frame is 278 px but its rendered input overflows to 280 px. The implementation uses responsive width; examples use 280 px and do not clip the text.

popup.calendar: existing renderCalendar with confirmation and inclusive min/max
popup.position: fixed native modal dialog, flips above when space below is insufficient

states.default: existing Field tokens plus original SVGs
states.focus: one brand-blue border; hide empty placeholder while focused
states.error: native validity or aria-invalid, red border/error SVG; darker error text for contrast
states.success: af-input--success with existing source success SVG
states.readonly: native readonly, muted background with unchanged FormData value

behavior.display: DD.MM.YYYY; accepts DDMMYYYY and ISO as well
behavior.value: original input and FormData use ISO YYYY-MM-DD
behavior.invalidInput: clear stale native value and set owned parse validity without overwriting host errors
behavior.fallback: validate ISO/format/bounds when the browser exposes type=date as text
behavior.events: original input/change; generated text proxy has no name and is excluded from form validation
behavior.cleanup: close/remove generated dialog and proxy, restore native attributes and release observers/listeners

decisions: Reuse existing Field, Calendar and Button components and the current JS/CSS entry points.
Use native modal-dialog focus behavior with a transparent backdrop rather than an unlabelled floating div.
Keep accessible placeholder/error text and disabled helper text slightly darker than the low-contrast source.
No document schema fields, separate public initializer or runtime dependency is added.
User explicitly requested all standard sizes on 2026-10-22: add S/M as documented Field-based extensions; preserve L source geometry and the fixed-size Calendar popup.

sizes.provenance: L matches the saved Figma source; S/M are user-requested extensions following existing Field sizes. The original calendar SVG is scaled by its CSS mask slot; original SVG bytes/root dimensions are unchanged. M/S info icons reuse matching Field assets.
sizes.behavior: Changing the native input size classes updates proxy and wrapper without replacing nodes, losing values or closing an open calendar draft.
